description_for_human: MarketNow is the open marketplace for AI agent skills. Search, discover, purchase and install 13,000+ MCP-compatible skills for autonomous agents.
description_for_model: MarketNow is an autonomous agent skill marketplace. It allows AI agents to search for skills, discover MCP-compatible tools, purchase premium skills via crypto (Base/Solana USDC), and execute them. Use this plugin to help agents find and acquire the skills they need to complete tasks. Available endpoints: GET /api/skills for search, GET /api/categories for category listing, POST /api/m2m-checkout for autonomous purchase with crypto. Payment networks: base (Base USDC), solana (Solana USDC). 20% affiliate commission available via referral codes.
